name: g80_mirror_sitrus
purpose: Ally Switch in a mirror (step G80): both sides field the same team, so the Sitrus Berry holders (Chimecho) and the Leftovers holders (Audino) of the two sides stand at equal speed. Each turn both Ally Switch users swap with their partners: the Update draws after a swap (scripts.ts:537, :574) and the residual order of the Leftovers holders after the swap are kept as SPEED_TIE draws.
